activities.title: Extract geometry & netlist
activities.description: Parse KiCad netlist (comps/nets) and extract footprint bbox + pad coordinates via pcbnew adapter into pure PartGeom records

activities.title: Anchor & affinity clustering
activities.description: Select main IC anchor (max pad count, deterministic tie-break) and assign passives to served pins (decap→power pin, crystal C→crystal pin, pullup→signal pin, connectors→board edge band)

activities.title: Greedy ring-band initial placement
activities.description: Place parts largest-first (R4) on ring-band grid slots minimizing affinity distance without AABB overlap

activities.title: Fixed-seed SA refinement
activities.description: Refine placement with simulated annealing over HPWL + affinity excess + overlap + edge penalties, sole randomness = random.Random(seed)

activities.title: Post-place rule check
activities.description: Check R1 decap distance and R8 die-shadow proxy; emit explainable violation list with source anchors
